thread:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up — Marigold Finance inked today. Terms: Dedicated GPU pool + hosted fallback. Go-live target 2026-04-12. SSO (SAML) and VPC peering needed. They care about low-latency embeddings.

Julie (CS): Taking point for onboarding. Can someone paste the sales summary + expected qps/peaks? Also flagging renewal watch: they insist on EU-only data residency in contract.

Sam (Sales): Sales summary: ARR $180k year 1. Primary contacts: alicia@marigold.co (product), raj@marigold.co (infra). Steady load ~20 rps, batch peaks to ~60 rps. Production in eu-west. Pitch doc: https://drive.redwood/marigold-sales-notes

Marta (Enablement): I'll run the enablement. Recommend two sessions: 1) Admin & SSO (30m), 2) Prompt engineering + evals (45m). Need sample prompts + 20 eval pairs by EOD next Tuesday. CS can we get those?

Julie (CS): @Sam can you ask Marigold for sample prompts and a PO for provisioning? I'll hold kickoff invite until we have SAML metadata and their IP ranges. Missing for provisioning: (a) SAML metadata file, (b) VPC CIDR & peering contact, (c) KMS policy if they're bringing keys, (d) list of model variants (embeddings vs chat).

Ben (Eng): Eng needs a scoped ticket for Private+Dedic. Create ENG- ticket with fields: customer, vpc_peering_required (yes/no), sso_type, kms_integration, expected_qps, latency_slo, test_dataset_size. Also include preferred quantization/instance types if known.

Sam (Sales): Tickets created: SUP-4322 tracks provisioning requests; ENG-2109 for infra work (VPC peering, KMS). Added sales notes and contract clause about EU residency.

deploy_bot: Reservation created: res-9c3f, provisional capacity reserved 2026-04-05 09:00 UTC.

Marta (Enablement): Uploads requested: 10 representative prompts + 20 eval pairs to https://drive.redwood/marigold-evals. I'll assemble a short playbook and run a smoke eval.

Julie (CS): Owners & next steps: Julie -> onboarding runbook and customer comms; Marta -> enablement sessions + evals; Ben -> ENG-2109 infra validation; Sam -> confirm prompts + SAML metadata; Support -> SUP-4322 tracks provisioning and procurements.

Ben (Eng): Quick technical ask: please paste SAML metadata (metadata.xml) and IdP entityID in ENG-2109. If they use SHA-256 signatures or enveloped assertions, call that out. Example snippet we expect in the ticket:

```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://idp.marigold.co">
  <!-- SAML metadata content -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Julie (CS): Scheduling kickoff for 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC. If SSO or peering are not ready by 3/29, escalate to eng on-call. Risk: if SAML/peering delayed, go-live may slip — mark renewal-watch in CRM and notify legal about EU residency caveat.

Sam (Sales): Will nudge Marigold for metadata and prompts today; will update CRM once received.

Julie (CS): Any additional cloud contacts needed for peering? If yes, post emails and I'll coordinate NDA/POC call.

Ben (Eng): Add raj@marigold.co and network@marigold.co to ENG-2109. We'll request a 1hr peering test window next week.

Marta (Enablement): Thanks — I'll draft invites and a short pre-kickoff survey to capture top failure modes and priority features.

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Good handoff. Julie — ping me if prompts aren't in by EOD.

Julie (CS): I'll publish a concise onboarding runbook in #cs-playbooks after kickoff and link SUP-4322 / ENG-2109. Everyone: react with :white_check_mark: when your action is done.
